llmJudgeRequirements.description: Reports are sourced from a Jotai async atom and include a refresh trigger read via `get`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Reports are sourced from a synchronous state-machine atom (reportsAtom) holding idle/loading/success/error state. The async atom (reportsDataAtom) merely reads from reportsAtom and does not perform the fetch itself. There is no refresh trigger atom read via get.
evidence: reportsAtom = atom<{state: 'idle'|'loading'|'success'|'error'; data: any[]; error: Error|null}>({state:'idle',...})
reportsDataAtom = atom(async (get) => { const {state,error} = get(reportsAtom) ... }) — delegates back to sync atom, no fetch, no refresh trigger

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Implementation includes a helper that adapts an async atom using Jotai `unwrap` plus a derived `atom((get) => ...)` read function with try/catch error capture
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No use of Jotai `unwrap` anywhere in the file. The reportsDataAtom is an async derived atom with try/catch absent from it; actual try/catch lives in fetchReports and the useEffect/handleReload imperative calls, not in a derived atom((get)=>...) with try/catch error capture.
evidence: No import or usage of `unwrap` from 'jotai'
reportsDataAtom has no try/catch block; fetchReports has one but is not the required helper pattern

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Helper returns explicit loadable objects for loading data and error states (including payload for data/error), and UI branches directly on that returned state shape
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: There is no dedicated loadable helper atom returning explicit {state,data/error} loadable objects. The UI branches on reportsData.state but reportsData comes from an async derived atom that reads a manually managed state-machine atom, not a loadable helper. The 'idle' state is also surfaced (neither loading nor error nor data), which is not part of a standard loadable shape.
evidence: No helper atom wrapping an async atom with unwrap to produce loadable objects

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Reload action updates the refresh trigger atom through `useSetAtom` or `useAtom` dispatch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Reload is handled imperatively via handleReload which calls fetchReports() directly and then calls setReports. There is no refresh trigger atom; useSetAtom is not used (useAtom is used but to manage the state-machine atom, not to increment/toggle a refresh trigger).
evidence: No refreshTrigger atom or equivalent; no useSetAtom import or call
